item.title: Senjou de Shoujo wa Kokoro o Sagasu
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cyc
  • 発売日: 2007-06-29
  • スコア: 6.58/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 戦場デ少女ハ心ヲサガス
  • 英語名: Senjou de Shoujo wa Kokoro o Sagasu

别名

  • Senjou de Shoujo wa Kokoro o Sasagu DS

あらすじ

Masato is a soldier. He lives happily with his fiancee, Megumi. But one day, his city is heavily bombed, and Megumi loses her life…. A few months later, he still can’t overcome saddness, and lives vacantly. One day, he is appointed as General of the army. “Perfect timing to die.” He accepts the offer, and a female-type battle android appears in front of him as his battle partner. A man who looks for a place to die and a battle android who looks for emotions…. Their battle now starts….

item.title: Senjou de Shoujo wa Karada o Kakeru
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cyc
  • 発売日: 2006-03-24
  • スコア: 6.21/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 戦場デ少女ハ躰ヲカケル
  • 英語名: Senjou de Shoujo wa Karada o Kakeru

あらすじ

Protagonist is a battle hardened soldier who enjoying his vacation in some famous tropical resort country. But his times of peace doesn’t last. There’s a swift and violent coup d’etat that leads our hero and his younger sister to be captured. Our hero’s exploits have caught the eye of the rebellious men, and they force him to join their cause and lead their troops while his sister is being held hostage. He goes along with their plot against his will, but who knows; perhaps he’ll discover the truth and feel that the rebels are on the side of right. Furthermore, it doesn’t hurt that there are a few attractive lady officers and mercenaries hanging around. How will their fates pan out in the fires of war?

item.title: Doujinshi Sokubaikai o Yarou!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cyc
  • 発売日: 2003-11-28
  • スコア: 6.69/10 (12 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 同人誌即売会をやろう！
  • 英語名: Doujinshi Sokubaikai o Yarou!

あらすじ

A talented artist with dreams and charisma, the protagonist has strived to lead a doujinshi circle towards success. Sadly, despite his ambition and drive, he lacks the financial resources and experience to break the barriers… until a beautiful woman offers both, expecting nothing in return except his best effort. Her future is now intertwined with his: can he prove to be the success she believes him to be?

item.title: Shin Ai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cyc
  • 発売日: 2002-05-10
  • スコア: 7.3/10 (10 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 神愛 ～Shin ai～
  • 英語名: Shin Ai

あらすじ

Every night, the hero has a strange dream.

“Help me … Help me please …” - says a mysterious girl on your dream.

Her voice looks familiar. You think you know that voice, but can’t remember. A friend gives to you an incomplete album. Somehow, the photos were removed. Looking every page in a hurry, you find three attached photos of strangers on the last page. There is a different landscape on each photo. The last one is one of a flowery desert garden, and one of a green meadow.

item.title: Hana Goyomi
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Cyc
  • 発売日: 2000-11-30
  • スコア: 6.2700000000000005/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 花暦
  • 英語名: Hana Goyomi

あらすじ

When he was a child, the protagonist used to play with someone at the flower garden of his grandfather until the day his family moved to the city.

Many years later, main character went to visit his grandfather, who felt ill at the hospital. He asks him to take care and rebuild his flower garden, because he can’t do it anymore.
